"snippet": "Step 3 — Fix manifests/bootstrap.json so it matches your actual repo
Goal: Ensure bootstrap points to the correct repo name and correct runtime paths.
What to do now

In your repo, open: manifests/bootstrap.json

Click the pencil icon (Edit).

Make these two edits (only these):

Set the repo name to exactly:

"repo": "metablooms-ltm"

Ensure the latest manifest path is exactly:

"latest_manifest_path": "manifests/latest.json"

Click Commit changes (commit to main).
